This is a substantive, diff-grounded performance/architecture concern on a public per-view path, not an incorrect-behavior defect.

judged_text: EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? runs an unindexed lower(host) SQL query on every embed/comments request, replacing the previous in-memory SiteSetting read on this public per-page-view path. Every blog page carrying the embed iframe now costs a sequential-scan query on the public comments endpoint; a high-traffic embedded site adds measurable DB load where the old path was served from the process-local settings cache.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes public embed host validation from an in-memory SiteSetting check to a DB lookup: EmbedController#ensure_embeddable and TopicRetriever#invalid_host? now call EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb, lib/topic_retriever.rb). That method calls record_for_host, which executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` adds no index on `host` and the `lower(host)` expression would not use a plain `host` index anyway, so this introduces a per-request query on a public path with potential performance/DB load implications compared to the previous process-local settings cache.
